result.title: The Forward/Inverse Duality of Controlled Emergence:A Computational Design Program from Explanation to Engineering
result.summary: The macroscopic capabilities of intelligent systems arise from the local interactions of many simple units. When such systems are deployed in the real world, their behaviour must nevertheless be constrained, leaving designers caught between releasing adaptability and preventing loss of control, yet without formal tools to resolve the dilemma. This paper proposes a unified research program for controlled emergence that restates this tension as a pair of dual problems: the forward problem explains macroscopic behaviour from local rules, and the inverse problem solves for controllable rules and readout mechanisms from a desired target. We take an augmented quintuple as the formal object shared by both ends, and decompose ``engineering'' into three independently measurable coordinates: controllability, reproducibility, and degree of formalizability. On this basis we give three testable working hypotheses (critical scale; the cooperation and trade-off between constraint and adaptability; minimal constraint) and one feasibility criterion, which reduce inverse design from unconstrained optimization to interval checking. The program takes explicit failure boundaries as its premise, does not pursue complete control, and always preserves the system's room for self-organization. The reduced pilot experiment attached to this paper serves only to verify the executability of the research protocol and does not constitute a statistical test of the working hypotheses. This design language generalizes to multi-agent artificial intelligence, the industrial internet, and emergency response systems, all of which must confront emergence and controllability at once.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出「受控涌现」的统一研究纲领，把局部规则与宏观行为的关系表述为正问题（由局部规则解释宏观行为）与反问题（由目标反解可控规则与读出机制），并给出可控性、可复现性、可形式化三个度量坐标、三条可检验假设与一个可行性判据，附带仅验证协议可执行性的小规模试点实验。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「反问题＋读出机制」的表述可能与 LVR 中由期望推理目标反解 latent 状态生成与读出方式的问题设定有概念联系，约束与自组织之间的权衡也可能类比 latent 工作区的信息坍缩与信息保留，但属跨领域启发，具体可迁移性需核查。
